task_description: Implement a production-ready cds-mbt npm package with full Joule agent integration, TLA+ export capability, comprehensive tests, and examples. This includes core infrastructure (CDS integration, templates, config files), Joule integration (machine extractor, ReAct templates, runtime adapter), TLA+ export (spec generator, TLC runner), unit tests, example projects, and documentation/CI.

key_achievements: Complete cds-mbt package with CLI and programmatic API
Joule agent integration with machine extraction and ReAct templates
TLA+ formal verification export with TLC runner
225 unit tests with >80% coverage on core modules
